messages:
Alex: Kicking off final pre-launch checks for the canary deploy in ~30m. Quick round: who is on smoke, rollback, and monitoring?
Jen: I can own smoke tests and run scripts. I'll be available for the 10:30 canary window.
Noah: I'm the rollback owner. If the canary fails, I'll run the rollback plan and notify infra.
Maya: I'll watch metrics/dashboards and tracing, and be ready to flip the canary toggle if latency spikes.
Omar: I'll be on standby for infra scaling / node issues. Have the kube RBAC checks been validated?
Alex: RBAC checks done earlier, Omar. Also tagging the deploy in CI: `deploy pipeline #release/2026.3` — deploy-bot should post status.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy pipeline #release/2026.3 -> canary at 2026-03-18T10:30:00Z. CI status: ✅ all checks passed.
Jen: Smoke checklist (short):
• Run `./scripts/smoke/canary_healthcheck.sh canary-1`
• Verify `GET /v1/health` and `POST /v1/generate` sample request (100 tokens)
• Check p95/p99 latency, error rate, and token cost delta
• Validate fallback route triggers on overload
Noah: Rollback plan reminder:
1) Pause traffic to canary group
2) Repoint route to stable model version `v4.2.1`
3) Confirm success via `GET /v1/health` and one generate call
4) Open incident if errors persist
Maya: Dashboards to watch: `deploy/canary/latency`, `deploy/canary/errors`, `platform/kv-cache-hits`. Alert thresholds set at +30% p95 and >0.5% 5m error rate.
Alex: Quick command for smoke run (jen, paste when running):
```
# run on jumpbox
./scripts/smoke/canary_healthcheck.sh canary-1 --sample "hello world" --tokens 100
```
Jen: Running smoke now (starting 10:31 UTC). Posting results in thread.
Jen: Smoke results: `GET /v1/health` -> 200, `generate` sample latency p95=45ms (baseline 40ms), errors=0, tokens=100. KV cache hit 68%.
Maya: Seeing the same on dashboards, small blip at 10:29 but stable now. p99 under 200ms.
Noah: No regressions. Rolling readiness: ready. I'll hold the rollback trigger if anything beyond these metrics appears.
Omar: Infra checks green. Autoscale headroom at 35%. No node OOMs.
Alex: Approvals: Jen (smoke) ✅, Noah (rollback) ✅, Maya (monitor) ✅, Omar (infra) ✅. Can we flip to canary traffic at 10:40 UTC?
Jen: :thumbsup: move forward.
Noah: Go for it. I'll monitor and be ready to rollback.
Maya: Monitoring in progress, alert hooks engaged.
Alex: OK initiating gradual traffic shift (10:40). I'll post status updates every 5 minutes.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift started: 5% -> canary group at 2026-03-18T10:40:00Z.
Alex: 10:45 update: canary at 20%, p95 stable, errors 0. Continuing.
Jen: Confirming generate sample at 20% still healthy.
Maya: Metrics holding. No anomaly. p95 +5% relative to baseline, within expected.
Noah: Still green. Rollback not needed.
Alex: 10:50 final: canary at 50% and stable. Proceeding with remainder rollout per schedule. Thanks team — I'll close this thread when fully complete.
Jen: Nice, great coordination :rocket:
Maya: Thanks all.
Noah: Good job.
Alex: Closing notes: update runbook with the small KV cache note (hit 68% vs usual 75%) — tagging eng-runtime to track. Closing thread.
Omar: Noted, will follow up in eng-runtime.
